selected_candidates.caption:
food is so poweful when it comes to fixing the gut!! here’s a pretty comprehensive list of foods I started eating consistently to heal my IBS, bloating, and constipation. My hope is this video makes it really easy to see WHY each food can be helpful for different reasons. 

** the bone broth I love to drink that tastes like hot chocolate is in my bi0!! 

#bloatingrelief #ibsrelief #bloatedstomach #bloatingtips #guthealthtips

Peas are a gut-health MVP: they bring fiber that helps keep digestion moving, plus prebiotic fibers that feed your beneficial gut bacteria. They also contain resistant starch and fermentable carbs that can support a healthier microbiome.

And here’s what makes them even more valuable—those fermentable fibers get broken down by your gut microbes into short-chain fatty acids like butyrate, which help nourish your gut lining, reduce inflammation, and support overall gut function. On top of that, peas provide plant-based protein and polyphenols that further support microbial diversity and metabolic health.

#plantbased #healthyfood #easyrecipes #fiber

Fix Your Gut Fast With Simple Juice Blends

Simple fruit and veggie drinks you can add to your morning routine for better hydration, digestion support, and cleaner daily nutrition. Save this so you can try one tomorrow.

#nutritiontips #healthyhabits #guthealth #wellnesstips #healthydrinks

Eating a large amount of sunflower seed shells can do more than just upset your stomach. The shells are mostly made of rough, indigestible fiber, so instead of breaking down, they can clump together, dry out, and form a painful fecal impaction. On the way out, those sharp shell fragments can also scrape the rectum and anus, causing pain, bleeding, and small tears. In other words, eat the seed, not the shell.

#ERdoctor #ConstipationRelief #DigestiveHealth #MedicalFacts

Quick fix for sudden stomach pain and bloating after outside food!
